Bill.BriefDescription: Providing unemployment and industrial insurance notices to employers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to unemployment and industrial insurance noticesrequired to be posted by employers; adding a new section to chapter50.12 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 51.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 50.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: When an employer initially files a master application under chapter19.02 RCW for the purpose, in whole or in part, of registering to payunemployment insurance taxes, the department shall send to the employerany printed material the department requires the employer to post underthis title.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 51.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: When an employer initially files a master application under chapter19.02 RCW for the purpose, in whole or in part, of registering to payindustrial insurance taxes, the department shall send to the employer p. 1 SB 5915any printed material the department requires the employer to post underthis title.
